Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert assumed that Eva Draconis's website could be accessed directly through her YouTube page without verifying the availability of the link in the "About" section. Instead of navigating to the YouTube page and confirming the presence of the website link, the agent proceeded to perform redundant web searches for the website and its banner symbol without grounding the investigation in actual evidence from the YouTube page. This misstep led to repetitive actions without yielding any meaningful progress towards solving the problem.
